capabilities: Render @settings blocks from themes, snippets, and plugin CSS as toggles, sliders, and color pickers
Save, import, export, and schedule presets capturing theme, snippets, settings, and accent color
Manage, filter, and toggle CSS snippets and themes from a unified panel
Edit CSS files in an integrated CodeMirror editor with smart @settings and @metadata insertion
Isolate style configurations per device alongside shared vault-wide settings
disambiguation: Not a theme or CSS framework itself; it manages existing themes, snippets, and their settings.
extras: Warns that Style Settings must be disabled while this plugin is enabled because both manage the same @settings system. Author discloses using Gemma AI for technical groundwork. Installable via BRAT, manual files, or the community store; accepts donations via Buy Me A Coffee.
intentEvidence: I've adapted several key parts of their codebase to jumpstart the development of this plugin.
motivation: The author cites error-prone manual editing of @settings blocks — repetitive boilerplate, fragile YAML indentation, and risky structural edits — which the plugin automates away.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to adjust theme and snippet CSS variables through controls, or to save, switch, and keep per-device whole style configurations.

relations.evidence: Do not enable Style Manager and Style Settings at the same time.
Tools marked with a (+) are adapted from the obsidian-theme-design-utilities project.
Install the BRAT plugin from the Obsidian Community Plugins store.

summary: Theme and CSS snippet manager that turns @settings blocks into adjustable controls and saves, imports, or schedules style configurations as presets.
